_about: The root-owned pieces a release needs OUTSIDE its own tree, in one list.
scripts/root_steps.py carries it out: from scripts/upgrade_steps.sh (root, by hand, --tree)
and from every over-the-air update (sudo, verified against the signed manifest, whose
'root' table pins the sha256 of this file and of every src below). install.sh writes the
same text on a fresh install; tests/smoke_rootsteps.py holds the copies equal.
0440, visudo-checked, {user} = the hub unit's User=; nft -> the rule file in
/usr/local/lib/irivai plus its oneshot unit, re-run only when changed or not loaded.
upgrade -> the one-time steps of scripts/upgrade_steps.sh an update can do by itself
(root_steps.py upgrade()): packages, the hub unit's baked --port, the NetworkManager
link-local drop-in, KillMode=process on the apply unit, /etc/mediamtx/mediamtx.yml
(Pipi H1; restarted, rolled back if it does not come up). Files pinned like every src.
Once per box: /var/lib/irivai/upgrade-steps.json records rev; a box with no record, or
an older rev, runs them. NOT here: the appliance defaults and --harden (operator
choices), which stay with upgrade_steps.sh by hand.

sudoers.name: irivai-update
sudoers.rule: {user} ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/bin/systemctl start --no-block irivai-apply.service, /usr/bin/systemctl restart irivai-hub.service, /usr/bin/systemctl ^restart irivai-master@[a-z0-9_-]+[.]service$, /usr/local/lib/irivai/flip-link.py

sudoers.name: irivai-box
sudoers.rule: {user} ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/sbin/shutdown now, /usr/sbin/reboot now, /sbin/shutdown now, /sbin/reboot now, /usr/bin/systemctl enable --now nodered, /usr/bin/systemctl disable --now nodered, /usr/bin/python3 -I /usr/local/lib/irivai/wifi-profile.py, /usr/bin/nmcli radio wifi on, /usr/bin/nmcli radio wifi off, /usr/bin/nmcli connection up *, /usr/bin/nmcli connection down *, /usr/bin/nmcli connection delete *, /usr/bin/nmcli connection modify *, /usr/bin/nmcli connection add type ethernet *, /usr/bin/nmcli device connect wlan0, !/usr/bin/nmcli -s *, !/usr/bin/nmcli * -s, !/usr/bin/nmcli * -s *, !/usr/bin/nmcli --show-secrets *, !/usr/bin/nmcli * --show-secrets, !/usr/bin/nmcli * --show-secrets *
